one_liner: Sends Discord messages when a player walks through a configurable trigger zone, with optional visual cube, color, opacity, and name exclusion list.
primary_use_case: Notify a Discord channel of player movement events inside a Hyperfy world.
preview_recommendation: Use the provided MP4 preview showing the trigger cube, its color/opacity settings, and the Discord webhook behavior.
manifest_quality_notes: Model (3 KB) and script (10 KB) are small.
Full UI configuration defined via app.configure.
Bug reported with the 'unique' toggle in description.
No media review needed; preview already present.
App is not public (public:false) but functional.
Multiple zones require manual copy‑paste of code.
